entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A former pit fighter turned nature druid who slew Laquatus with the Mirari sword and seeks to save his sister Jeska from the Cabal.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, transformed by the Cabal into Phage, who becomes herself again when she expels her deathwurms.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: The Cabal's deadly weapon created out of Jeska, with a putrefying touch and great battle mastery, who despises Kamahl.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A centaur whose hut sheltered Jeska and who is killed by Braids.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A cabalist dementist who takes Jeska, kills Seton and arranges Kamahl's matches against Phage.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: A street illusionist left to die in the desert who discovers miraculous powers and builds the kingdom of Topos.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: A former Order mage and Ixidor's lover, killed by Phage.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angel with Nivea's face, created by Ixidor in his sleep, who defends him and fights Phage and the wurms.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: The leader of the Cabal based in Aphetto, who builds the Grand Coliseum and allies with Kamahl against Ixidor.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: The criminal organization running pit fights from Aphetto.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: The Cabal's headquarters city where the pits are located.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: The forest where Mirari-induced growth runs out of control and where Kamahl builds his army.

entities.name: Topos
entities.description: The verdant kingdom Ixidor creates in the desert, with its palace Locus.

entities.name: Locus
entities.description: The palace of Ixidor in Topos.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: The great arena built by the Cabal as the new center of Otaria's commerce and culture.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: A centaur leader renamed Stonebrow, who becomes Kamahl's general after mutation.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: A mule driver chosen by Phage as her official spokesperson.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merman slain by Kamahl with the Mirari sword.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: The artifact whose power causes cancer-like growth in Krosa and powers Kamahl's sword.

entities.name: Soul Reaper
entities.description: An ax forged by uniting the Cabal's and Kamahl's weapons with enough power to kill Akroma.

entities.name: Deathwurms
entities.description: Enormous wurms expelled by Phage as embodiments of her murders.

events.summary: Kamahl has just slain Laquatus with the Mirari sword, causing vegetation to flourish around it.
events.quote: Kamahl has just slain Laquatus using the Mirari sword.

events.summary: Braids takes Jeska from Seton's hut and kills Seton; Kamahl finds the hut burned and his sister missing.
events.quote: Seton opposed this, and the dementist killed him.

events.summary: Phage kills Nivea in the pits and Ixidor, bankrupted by the loss, is left naked in the desert swearing revenge.
events.quote: Created out of Jeska, she has a putrefying touch and great battle mastery, and she easily subdues the duo, killing Nivea.

events.summary: The Cabal strip Ixidor and abandon him in the desert after discovering his forged coins.
events.quote: The Cabal officers knock him out and leave him naked in the desert, where he swears revenge upon Phage.

events.summary: Kamahl fights Phage in the pits but his sister does not recognize him, so he stops the match and returns to Krosa to build an army.
events.quote: Rejected, Kamahl stops the match and returns to Krosa, where he decides to build an army to defeat the Cabal and rescue his sister.

events.summary: The First commands the construction of the Grand Coliseum and Phage oversees the works.
events.quote: he commands the construction of the Grand Coliseum

events.summary: Ixidor discovers his illusion powers and builds the kingdom of Topos.
events.quote: Soon he built his kingdom, known as Topos

events.summary: Ixidor dreams Phage has come for him and wakes with the angel Akroma, whom he sends to eliminate Phage.
events.quote: He agrees, then sends her to eliminate Phage.

events.summary: Kamahl mutates the Krosan centaurs into powerful beasts and forms an army under Stonebrow.
events.quote: Their leader Bron is renamed Stonebrow and becomes Kamahl's general.

events.summary: Akroma interrupts Kamahl's second fight with Phage; Kamahl cuts the angel's legs and she flees.
events.quote: the druid cuts the angel's legs, and Akroma flees.

events.summary: The Cabal and Kamahl form a truce and an army, forging the Soul Reaper to kill Akroma.
events.quote: create the Soul Reaper, an ax with enough power to kill Akroma.

events.summary: Ixidor's spark makes nightmares real; Phage expels deathwurms and is Jeska again.
events.quote: she is Jeska once again, and she exchanges a few tender words with her brother.

events.summary: A deathwurm devours Ixidor after his unmen betray him.
Jeska absorbs the wurms back and becomes Phage again, despising Kamahl.
events.quote: she returns to being Phage and once again despises the druid

events.summary: Akroma takes control of Topos and Kamahl swears to save his sister.

relations.quote: where he had left his sister Jeska to be cured

relations.note: She despises him for making her what she is.
relations.quote: despises the druid for his role in making her what she is
Seton opposed this, and the dementist killed him.

relations.note: She kills her in the pits.
relations.quote: she easily subdues the duo, killing Nivea.

relations.note: He created her during his sleep.
relations.quote: Akroma explains he must have created her during his sleep due to his troubles.

relations.note: Embodiments of her murders expelled from her.
relations.quote: They are the embodiment of each of her murders, and represent her dark soul
